deviations.description: 'Add a doc_id -> provenance_fidelity lookup against $GLOBAL_INDEX, mirroring the existing relevance lookup (per-repo, ~line 197)'
deviations.reason: Not actually a deviation, documented here to record why this differs from Phase 3's fix. literature-briefing.sh's per-repo mode `doc_id` variable is drawn from specs/literature-index.json, which is curated in index.json's OWN `.id` namespace (confirmed against two real per-repo sub-indexes: BimodalLogic and cslib both reference doc_id values that are literal index.json `.id` values, e.g. 'rabinovich_2014', 'kamp_1968_tense-logic-linear-order') -- this is the SAME namespace the existing title/authors/year/chunk_count lookups in this function already use (`select(.id == $id)`). This is a genuinely different namespace from literature-search.sh's chunks_data.doc_id (bare directory name) fixed in Phase 3 -- the two scripts' `doc_id` variables are not interchangeable, and the plan's literal `.id`-keyed mirroring instruction is correct here. Global mode needs no separate lookup at all: literature-search.sh's do_search (fixed in Phase 3) already returns a directory-name-keyed provenance_fidelity field on every result object, and literature-briefing.sh's global mode consumes that JSON directly.
